finalText:
Migrated the 12 remaining files still on `db.query` — spread across accounts, orders, billing, analytics, support, and catalog — swapping each call for the `db.execute({ sql, params })` form already used elsewhere. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and all `cache.query` calls untouched, since those aren't part of the migration.

`verify.js` confirms it: every call site moved, nothing else was touched, and all modules still load and run correctly.
